sources.author: Jack Twilley

strategy.text: This program is designed to copy off seven small portions
of code whose sole purpose is to find something abnormal.
If they do, then they set a flag in their routine to a
non-zero value, and wait until it becomes zero again.
The second part of the program scans each of the small
portion's flags, and based on the response, bombs a
certain portion of core heavily.  Having completed that,
then it resumes scanning the other pointers.

strategy.text: Kinch looks for non-zero B-fields
and bombs the region with jumps to
a "slave pit".  The pit then changes
my program so that it simply bombs
memory (every single address) w/dat 's
(and then the pit splits ad infinitum).

is executing little else than spl 's)
we win. That's why it cleans up against
things which split alot.
MAJOR WEAKNESS: Very long if the searching
looks at more than B-fields.
THING-TO-FIX: Find out why it draws so much
and stop doing so (35% wins and 65% losses
is BETTER than all draws)
